# Architecture

The repo is a single **Frappe app** (`healthcare`) plus a separate Vue SPA (`patient_portal/`). Its build output is committed into the app's public folder.

## Top-level layout
| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `healthcare/hooks.py` | App wiring: doc_events, scheduler_events, override_doctype_class, jinja methods, install/migrate hooks, global search |
| `healthcare/healthcare/` | The "Healthcare" module (the only entry in `modules.txt`) |
| `healthcare/healthcare/doctype/<snake_name>/` | One folder per DocType: `<name>.json` (schema), `<name>.py` (controller), `<name>.js` (form script), optional `_list.js`/`_calendar.js`, `test_<name>.py` |
| `healthcare/healthcare/custom_doctype/` | Extensions to ERPNext doctypes (e.g. `HealthcareSalesInvoice`, payment_entry handlers) |
| `healthcare/healthcare/api/` | Whitelisted HTTP APIs (`patient_portal.py`) |
| `healthcare/healthcare/{report,page,print_format,workspace,dashboard_chart,number_card,web_form,setup}` | Standard Frappe artifacts |
| `healthcare/healthcare/utils.py` | Shared billing/invoice helpers referenced from hooks |
| `healthcare/controllers/` | Shared controllers (`service_request_controller.py`, link `queries.py`) |
| `healthcare/regional/india/abdm/` | Country-specific (ABDM) integration |
| `healthcare/patches/` + `patches.txt` | Versioned data migrations (`v0_0`, `v15_0`, `v16_0`), split into `[pre_model_sync]` and `[post_model_sync]` |
| `healthcare/setup.py`, `install.py`, `uninstall.py`, `after_migrate.py` | Install/migrate lifecycle |
| `healthcare/public/js/` | Desk JS bundle and shared form helpers |
| `healthcare/www/patient_portal.{html,py}` | Server entry for the SPA |
| `patient_portal/` | Vue 3 + frappe-ui SPA source |
| `healthcare/tests/` | Shared test bootstrap (`BootStrapTestData`) |
| `wiki/` | Design docs and user guides |

## How the parts call each other
- **Healthcare → ERPNext/Frappe:** controllers subclass Frappe `Document`. Hooks attach to ERPNext doctypes (`Sales Invoice`, `Payment Entry`, `Company`) through `doc_events`, and `Sales Invoice` is overridden with `override_doctype_class`. Billing creates ERPNext Sales Invoices.
- **Generic medical records:** a wildcard `"*"` `on_submit`/`on_cancel` hook in `patient_history_settings` writes Patient Medical Records for every submitted document.
- **Background work:** `scheduler_events` (appointment reminders, daily status updates, IP billables, expiring medication requests) and `frappe.enqueue` for long jobs such as recurring appointments.
- **Desk UI → server:** form scripts call `frappe.call` on `@frappe.whitelist()` methods in the doctype controllers.
- **Portal → server:** the SPA calls `healthcare.healthcare.api.patient_portal.*` whitelisted methods through frappe-ui resources. Vite builds the SPA into `healthcare/public/frontend` and renders it via `www/patient_portal.html`.
- Business logic and validation live **server-side** (PR template rule).
